text: And thou shalt go on forward from thence, and shalt come to the oak of Tabor, and there shall meet thee three men going up to God, to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three cakes of bread, and another carrying a flask of wine.

title: I Samuel 10:4
text: And they will ask after thy welfare, and give thee two loaves, which thou shalt receive of their hands.

title: I Samuel 10:5
text: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where are the outposts of the Philistines; and it shall come to pass, when thou comest thither, into the city, that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with lute and tambour and pipe and harp before them; and they themselves prophesying.

title: I Samuel 10:6
text: And the Spirit of Jehovah will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.

title: I Samuel 10:7
text: And it shall be, when these signs shall come to thee, thou shalt do as thy hand shall find; for God is with thee.

title: I Samuel 10:8
text: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to thee, to offer up burnt-offerings, [and] to sacrifice sacrifices of peace-offerings: seven days shalt thou wait, until I come to thee and inform thee what thou shalt do.

title: I Samuel 10:9
text: ¶And it was [so] that when he turned his back to go away from Samuel, God gave him another heart; and all those signs came to pass that day.

title: I Samuel 10:10
text: And when they came thither to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came upon him, and he prophesied among them.

title: I Samuel 10:11
text: And it came to pass, when all that knew him before saw that, behold, he prophesied among the prophets, then the people said one to another, What is this that has happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?

title: I Samuel 10:12
text: And a man of that place answered and said, But who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?

title: I Samuel 10:13
text: And when he had ended prophesying, he came to the high place.

title: I Samuel 10:14
text: And Saul's uncle said to him and to his servant, Whither went ye? And he said, To seek the asses; and when we saw that they were nowhere, we went to Samuel.

title: I Samuel 10:15
text: And Saul's uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said to you.

title: I Samuel 10:16
text: And Saul said to his uncle, He told us for certain that the asses were found. But of the matter of the kingdom, of which Samuel had spoken, he told him not.

title: I Samuel 10:17
text: ¶And Samuel called the people together to Jehovah to Mizpah.

title: I Samuel 10:18
text: And he said to the children of Israel, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, *I* brought up Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you;

title: I Samuel 10:19
text: but *ye* have this day rejected your God, who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your troubles, and have said unto him, [Nay,] but a king shalt thou set over us. Now therefore present yourselves before Jehovah by your tribes, and by your thousands.

title: I Samuel 10:20
text: And Samuel caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, and the tribe of Benjamin was taken.

title: I Samuel 10:21
text: And he caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, and the family of Matri was taken; and Saul the son of Kish was taken. And they sought him, but he was not to be found.

title: I Samuel 10:22
text: Therefore they inquired of Jehovah further, Will the man yet come hither? And Jehovah answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the baggage.

title: I Samuel 10:23
text: And they ran and fetched him thence; and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.

title: I Samuel 10:24
text: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom Jehovah has chosen, that there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted and said, May the king live.

title: I Samuel 10:25
text: And Samuel told the people the right of the kingdom, and wrote it in the book, and laid it before Jehovah. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.

title: I Samuel 10:26
text: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and with him went the band, whose hearts God had touched.

title: I Samuel 10:27
text: But the children of Belial said, How should this man save us? And they despised him, and brought him no gifts. But he was as one deaf.

title: I Samuel 11:1
text: ¶And Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh-Gilead. And all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.

title: I Samuel 11:2
text: And Nahash the Ammonite said to them, On this [condition] will I treat with you, that I thrust out all your right eyes, and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel.

title: I Samuel 11:3
text: And the elders of Jabesh said to him, Allow us seven days, and we will send messengers into all the districts of Israel; and if there be no man to deliver us, we will come out to thee.

title: I Samuel 11:4
text: And the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and told these words in the ears of the people. And all the people lifted up their voice and wept.

title: I Samuel 11:5
text: ¶And behold, Saul came after the oxen from the field; and Saul said, What [aileth] the people that they weep? And they related to him the words of the men of Jabesh.

title: I Samuel 11:6
text: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those words, and his anger was kindled greatly.

title: I Samuel 11:7
text: And he took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces, and sent throughout the territory of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, Whoever comes not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done to his oxen! And the fear of Jehovah fell on the people, and they came out as one man.

title: I Samuel 11:8
text: And he numbered them in Bezek, and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

title: I Samuel 11:9
text: And they said to the messengers that had come, Thus shall ye say to the men of Jabesh-Gilead: To-morrow ye shall have deliverance when the sun is hot. And the messengers came and informed the men of Jabesh-Gilead; and they were glad.

title: I Samuel 11:10
text: And the men of Jabesh said, To-morrow we will come out to you, and ye may do with us according to all that is good in your sight.

title: I Samuel 11:11
text: And it came to pass the next day that Saul set the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the camp in the morning watch, and smote Ammon until the heat of the day: and it came to pass that they who remained were scattered, and not two of them were left together.

title: I Samuel 11:12
text: ¶And the people said to Samuel, Who is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.

title: I Samuel 11:13
text: But Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day; for to-day Jehovah has wrought deliverance in Israel.

title: I Samuel 11:14
text: And Samuel said to the people, Come and let us go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.

title: I Samuel 11:15
text: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before Jehovah in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed peace-offerings before Jehovah. And there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced exceedingly.

title: I Samuel 12:1
text: ¶And Samuel said to all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened to your voice in all that ye said to me, and have made a king over you.

title: I Samuel 12:2
text: And now behold, the king walks before you; and I am old and grey-headed; and behold, my sons are with you; and I have walked before you from my youth up to this day.

title: I Samuel 12:3
text: Here I am: testify against me before Jehovah, and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I injured? or of whose hand have I received any ransom and blinded mine eyes therewith? and I will restore it to you.

title: I Samuel 12:4
text: And they said, Thou hast not defrauded us, and thou hast not injured us, neither hast thou taken aught of any man's hand.

title: I Samuel 12:5
text: And he said to them, Jehovah is witness against you, and his anointed is witness this day, that ye have not found aught in my hand! And [the people] said, [He is] witness!

title: I Samuel 12:6
text: ¶And Samuel said to the people, [It is] Jehovah who appointed Moses and Aaron, and who brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

title: I Samuel 12:7
text: And now stand still, that I may plead with you before Jehovah of all the righteous acts of Jehovah which he did to you and to your fathers.

title: I Samuel 12:8
text: When Jacob had come into Egypt, and your fathers cried to Jehovah, then Jehovah sent Moses and Aaron, and they brought your fathers forth out of Egypt, and made them dwell in this place.

title: I Samuel 12:9
text: And they forgot Jehovah their God, and he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.

title: I Samuel 12:10
text: And they cried to Jehovah and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken Jehovah, and have served the Baals and the Ashtoreths; and now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.

title: I Samuel 12:11
text: And Jehovah sent Jerubbaal and Bedan and Jephthah and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies round about, so that ye dwelt in safety.

title: I Samuel 12:12
text: But when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, ye said to me, Nay, but a king shall reign over us; when Jehovah your God was your king.

title: I Samuel 12:13
text: And now behold, the king whom ye have chosen, whom ye have asked for! and behold, Jehovah has set a king over you.

title: I Samuel 12:14
text: If ye fear Jehovah, and serve him, and hearken to his voice, and rebel not against the commandment of Jehovah, then both ye and the king also that reigns over you shall continue following Jehovah your God.

title: I Samuel 12:15
text: But if ye will not hearken to the voice of Jehovah, and if ye rebel against the commandment of Jehovah, then will the hand of Jehovah be against you, as against your fathers.

title: I Samuel 12:16
text: ¶Now therefore stand and see this great thing which Jehovah will do before your eyes.

title: I Samuel 12:17
text: Is it not wheat-harvest to-day? I will call unto Jehovah, and he will send thunder and rain; and ye shall perceive and see that your wickedness is great which ye have done in the sight of Jehovah in asking for yourselves a king.

title: I Samuel 12:18
text: And Samuel called to Jehovah; and Jehovah sent thunder and rain that day. And all the people greatly feared Jehovah and Samuel.

title: I Samuel 12:19
text: And all the people said to Samuel, Pray to Jehovah thy God for thy servants, that we die not; for we have added to all our sins the wickedness to ask for ourselves a king.

title: I Samuel 12:20
text: And Samuel said to the people, Fear not: *ye* have done all this wickedness; yet turn not aside from following Jehovah, and serve Jehovah with all your heart;

title: I Samuel 12:21
text: and turn ye not aside; for [it would be] after vain things which cannot profit nor deliver; for they are vain.

title: I Samuel 12:22
text: For Jehovah will not cast away his people for his great name's sake; because it has pleased Jehovah to make you his people.

title: I Samuel 12:23
text: Moreover, as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against Jehovah in ceasing to pray for you; and I will teach you the good and right way.

title: I Samuel 12:24
text: Only, fear Jehovah, and serve him in truth, with all your heart; for see how great things he has done for you.

title: I Samuel 12:25
text: But if ye do wickedly, ye shall perish, both ye and your king.

title: I Samuel 13:1
text: ¶Saul was...years old when he became king; and he reigned two years over Israel.

title: I Samuel 13:2
text: And Saul chose him three thousand men out of Israel: there were with Saul two thousand in Michmash and in mount Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin; and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.

title: I Samuel 13:3
text: And Jonathan smote the outpost of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard [of it]. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.

title: I Samuel 13:4
text: And all Israel heard say, Saul has smitten the garrison of the Philistines, and Israel also has become odious to the Philistines. And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal.

title: I Samuel 13:5
text: And the Philistines were assembled together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea-shore in multitude; and they came up, and encamped in Michmash, eastward from Beth-Aven.

title: I Samuel 13:6
text: And the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait (for the people were distressed); and the people hid themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in cliffs, and in strongholds, and in pits.

title: I Samuel 13:7
text: And the Hebrews went over the Jordan into the land of Gad and Gilead. And Saul was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

title: I Samuel 13:8
text: ¶And he waited seven days, according to the set time that Samuel [had appointed]; but Samuel did not come to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.

title: I Samuel 13:9
text: And Saul said, Bring hither to me the burnt-offering and the peace-offerings. And he offered up the burnt-offering.

title: I Samuel 13:10
text: And it came to pass, as soon as he had ended offering up the burnt-offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.

title: I Samuel 13:11
text: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that thou didst not come within the days appointed, and that the Philistines were assembled at Michmash,

title: I Samuel 13:12
text: I said, The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication to Jehovah; and I forced myself, and offered up the burnt-offering.

title: I Samuel 13:13
text: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of Jehovah thy God which he commanded thee; for now would Jehovah have established thy kingdom over Israel for ever.

title: I Samuel 13:14
text: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: Jehovah has sought him a man after his own heart, and Jehovah has appointed him ruler over his people; for thou hast not kept what Jehovah commanded thee.

title: I Samuel 13:15
text: ¶And Samuel arose and went up from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were found with him, about six hundred men.

title: I Samuel 13:16
text: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people that were found with them, abode in Geba of Benjamin; and the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

title: I Samuel 13:17
text: And the ravagers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned the way of Ophrah, into the land of Shual;

title: I Samuel 13:18
text: and another company turned the way to Beth-horon; and the other company turned the way to the district that looks over the ravine of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

title: I Samuel 13:19
text: Now there was no smith found throughout the land of Israel; for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears.

title: I Samuel 13:20
text: And all Israel went down to the Philistines, every man to get his ploughshare, and his hoe, and his axe, and his sickle sharpened,

title: I Samuel 13:21
text: when the edges of the sickles, and the hoes, and the forks, and the axes were blunted; and to set the goads.

title: I Samuel 13:22
text: And it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan; but with Saul and with Jonathan his son there was found.

title: I Samuel 13:23
text: And a garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.

title: I Samuel 14:1
text: ¶Now it came to pass one day that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man that bore his armour, Come and let us go over to the Philistines' garrison which is on the other side. But he did not tell his father.

title: I Samuel 14:2
text: And Saul abode at the extreme end of Gibeah under the pomegranate-tree which [was] in Migron; and the people that were with him were about six hundred men.

title: I Samuel 14:3
text: (And Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, Jehovah's priest in Shiloh, wore the ephod.) And the people did not know that Jonathan was gone.

title: I Samuel 14:4
text: Now between the passes by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines' garrison there was a sharp rock on the one side and a sharp rock on the other side; and the name of the one [was] Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

title: I Samuel 14:5
text: The one crag [formed] a pillar on the north opposite to Michmash, and the other on the south opposite to Geba.

title: I Samuel 14:6
text: And Jonathan said to the young man that bore his armour, Come, and let us go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised: perhaps Jehovah will work for us; for there is no restraint to Jehovah to save by many or by few.

title: I Samuel 14:7
text: And his armour-bearer said to him, Do all that is in thy heart; turn thee; behold, I am with thee according to thy heart.

title: I Samuel 14:8
text: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over to the men, and we will shew ourselves to them.

title: I Samuel 14:9
text: If they say thus to us, Stand still until we come to you, then we will stay in our place, and will not go up to them.

title: I Samuel 14:10
text: And if they say thus, Come up to us, then we will go up; for Jehovah has given them into our hand; and this shall be the sign to us.

title: I Samuel 14:11
text: And both of them shewed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines; and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.

title: I Samuel 14:12
text: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armour-bearer and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you something. And Jonathan said to his armour-bearer, Come up after me; for Jehovah has delivered them into the hand of Israel.

title: I Samuel 14:13
text: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armour-bearer after him; and they fell before Jonathan; and his armour-bearer slew after him.

title: I Samuel 14:14
text: And that first slaughter which Jonathan and his armour-bearer wrought was about twenty men, as it were on the half-furrow of an acre of land.

title: I Samuel 14:15
text: And there was trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people; the garrison, and the ravagers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked; for it was a trembling [from] God.

title: I Samuel 14:16
text: ¶And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked, and behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on slaying one another.

title: I Samuel 14:17
text: Then said Saul to the people that were with him, Muster now, and see who is gone from us. And they mustered, and behold, Jonathan and his armour-bearer were not there.

title: I Samuel 14:18
text: And Saul said to Ahijah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.

title: I Samuel 14:19
text: And it came to pass while Saul talked to the priest, that the noise which was in the camp of the Philistines went on and increased; and Saul said to the priest, Withdraw thy hand.

title: I Samuel 14:20
text: And Saul and all the people that were with him were called together, and they came to the battle; and behold, every man's sword was against his fellow, a very great confusion.

title: I Samuel 14:21
text: And there were Hebrews with the Philistines before that time, who had gone up with them into the camp round about; and they also [turned] to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

title: I Samuel 14:22
text: And all the men of Israel who had hid themselves in mount Ephraim heard that the Philistines fled, and they also followed hard after them in the battle.

title: I Samuel 14:23
text: And Jehovah saved Israel that day; and the battle passed over beyond Beth-Aven.

title: I Samuel 14:24
text: ¶But the men of Israel were distressed that day. Now Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth food until evening, and [until] I am avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted food.

title: I Samuel 14:25
text: And all they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey on the ground.

title: I Samuel 14:26
text: And the people had come into the wood, and behold, the honey flowed; but no man put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath.

title: I Samuel 14:27
text: But Jonathan had not heard when his father adjured the people; and he put forth the end of his staff which was in his hand, and dipped it in the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth, and his eyes became bright.

title: I Samuel 14:28
text: Then answered one of the people and said, Thy father strictly adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth food this day; and the people are faint.

title: I Samuel 14:29
text: And Jonathan said, My father has troubled the land: see, I pray you, that mine eyes are bright, because I tasted a little of this honey.

title: I Samuel 14:30
text: How much more, if the people had eaten freely to-day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for would there not now have been a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?

title: I Samuel 14:31
text: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Ajalon; and the people were very faint.

title: I Samuel 14:32
text: And the people fell on the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slaughtered them on the ground; and the people ate [them] with the blood.

title: I Samuel 14:33
text: And they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against Jehovah, in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have acted perversely: roll me now a great stone.

title: I Samuel 14:34
text: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say to them, Bring near to me every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slaughter them here, and eat; and sin not against Jehovah in eating with the blood. And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and slaughtered [them] there.

title: I Samuel 14:35
text: And Saul built an altar to Jehovah: this was the first altar he built to Jehovah.

title: I Samuel 14:36
text: ¶And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and plunder them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatsoever is good in thy sight. Then said the priest, Let us come near hither to God.

title: I Samuel 14:37
text: And Saul inquired of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou give them into the hand of Israel? But he did not answer him that day.

title: I Samuel 14:38
text: And Saul said, Draw ye near hither, all the heads of the people; and know and see wherein this sin has been this day.

title: I Samuel 14:39
text: For, [as] Jehovah liveth, who has saved Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall certainly die. And no one answered him among all the people.

title: I Samuel 14:40
text: Then said he to all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said to Saul, Do what is good in thy sight.

title: I Samuel 14:41
text: And Saul said to Jehovah the God of Israel, Give a perfect [testimony]! And Jonathan and Saul were taken, and the people escaped.

title: I Samuel 14:42
text: And Saul said, Cast [lots] between me and Jonathan my son. And Jonathan was taken.

title: I Samuel 14:43
text: And Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him and said, With the end of the staff which is in my hand I tasted a little honey, [and] behold, I must die!

title: I Samuel 14:44
text: And Saul said, God do so [to me] and more also; thou shalt certainly die, Jonathan.

title: I Samuel 14:45
text: And the people said to Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who has wrought this great salvation in Israel? Far be it! [as] Jehovah liveth, there shall not a hair of his head fall to the ground; for he has wrought with God this day. So the people delivered Jonathan, that he died not.

title: I Samuel 14:46
text: And Saul went up from following the Philistines; and the Philistines went to their own place.

title: I Samuel 14:47
text: ¶And Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies round about, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines; and whithersoever he turned himself, he discomfited [them].

title: I Samuel 14:48
text: And he did valiantly, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of their spoilers.

title: I Samuel 14:49
text: And the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Jishvi, and Malchi-shua. And the names of his two daughters: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.

title: I Samuel 14:50
text: And the name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz; and the name of the captain of his host was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.

title: I Samuel 14:51
text: And Kish the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner were sons of Abiel.

title: I Samuel 14:52
text: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul; and when Saul saw any mighty man, or any valiant man, he took him to himself.

title: I Samuel 15:1
text: ¶And Samuel said to Saul, Jehovah sent *me* to anoint thee king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken to the voice of the words of Jehovah.

title: I Samuel 15:2
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: I have considered what Amalek did to Israel, how he set himself against him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.

title: I Samuel 15:3
text: Now go and smite Amalek, and destroy utterly all that they have, and spare them not, but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.

title: I Samuel 15:4
text: And Saul summoned the people, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.

title: I Samuel 15:5
text: And Saul came to the city of the Amalekites, and set an ambush in the valley.

title: I Samuel 15:6
text: And Saul said to the Kenites, Go, depart, and go down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them; for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel when they came up out of Egypt. And the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

title: I Samuel 15:7
text: And Saul smote Amalek from Havilah as thou comest to Shur, which is opposite to Egypt.

title: I Samuel 15:8
text: And he took Agag the king of Amalek alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

title: I Samuel 15:9
text: And Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep and oxen, and beasts of the second bearing, and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not devote them to destruction; but everything that was mean and weak, that they destroyed utterly.

title: I Samuel 15:10
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came to Samuel, saying,

title: I Samuel 15:11
text: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king; for he is turned away from following me, and hath not fulfilled my words. And Samuel was much grieved; and he cried to Jehovah all night.

title: I Samuel 15:12
text: And Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning. And it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set him up a monument, and has turned about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.

title: I Samuel 15:13
text: And Samuel came to Saul; and Saul said to him, Blessed art thou of Jehovah: I have fulfilled the word of Jehovah.

title: I Samuel 15:14
text: And Samuel said, What [means] then this bleating of sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of oxen which I hear?

title: I Samuel 15:15
text: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites, because the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice to Jehovah thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.

title: I Samuel 15:16
text: And Samuel said to Saul, Stay, that I may tell thee what Jehovah has said to me this night. And he said to him, Say on.

title: I Samuel 15:17
text: And Samuel said, Was it not when thou wast little in thine eyes that thou [becamest] the head of the tribes of Israel, and Jehovah anointed thee king over Israel?

title: I Samuel 15:18
text: And Jehovah sent thee on a way and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.

title: I Samuel 15:19
text: Why then didst thou not hearken to the voice of Jehovah, but didst fall upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of Jehovah?

title: I Samuel 15:20
text: And Saul said to Samuel, I have indeed hearkened to the voice of Jehovah, and have gone the way which Jehovah sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

title: I Samuel 15:21
text: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the choicest of the devoted things, to sacrifice to Jehovah thy God in Gilgal.

title: I Samuel 15:22
text: And Samuel said, Has Jehovah delight in burnt-offerings and sacrifices, As in hearkening to the voice of Jehovah? Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, Attention than the fat of rams.

title: I Samuel 15:23
text: For rebellion is [as] the sin of divination, And selfwill is [as] iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of Jehovah, He hath also rejected thee from being king.

title: I Samuel 15:24
text: ¶And Saul said to Samuel, I have sinned, for I have transgressed the commandment of Jehovah, and thy words; for I feared the people, and hearkened to their voice.

title: I Samuel 15:25
text: And now, I pray thee, forgive my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship Jehovah.

title: I Samuel 15:26
text: And Samuel said to Saul, I will not turn again with thee; for thou hast rejected the word of Jehovah, and Jehovah has rejected thee from being king over Israel.

title: I Samuel 15:27
text: And as Samuel turned to go away, [Saul] laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.

title: I Samuel 15:28
text: Then Samuel said to him, Jehovah has rent the kingdom of Israel from thee to-day, and has given it to thy neighbour, who is better than thou.

title: I Samuel 15:29
text: And also the Hope of Israel will not lie nor repent; for he is not a man, that he should repent.

title: I Samuel 15:30
text: And he said, I have sinned; honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship Jehovah thy God.

title: I Samuel 15:31
text: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped Jehovah.

title: I Samuel 15:32
text: ¶And Samuel said, Bring ye near to me Agag the king of Amalek. And Agag came to him gaily. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.

title: I Samuel 15:33
text: And Samuel said, As thy sword has made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless above women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before Jehovah in Gilgal.

title: I Samuel 15:34
text: And Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

title: I Samuel 15:35
text: And Samuel saw Saul no more until the day of his death; for Samuel mourned over Saul; and Jehovah repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.

title: I Samuel 16:1
text: ¶And Jehovah said to Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thy horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Bethlehemite; for I have provided me a king among his sons.

title: I Samuel 16:2
text: And Samuel said, How shall I go? if Saul hear [it], he will kill me. And Jehovah said, Take a heifer with thee, and say, I am come to sacrifice to Jehovah.

title: I Samuel 16:3
text: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will tell thee what thou shalt do; and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee.

title: I Samuel 16:4
text: And Samuel did what Jehovah said, and came to Bethlehem. And the elders of the city came trembling to meet him, and said, Dost thou come peaceably?

title: I Samuel 16:5
text: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice to Jehovah. Hallow yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he hallowed Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

title: I Samuel 16:6
text: ¶And it came to pass when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely Jehovah's anointed is before him.

title: I Samuel 16:7
text: But Jehovah said to Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have rejected him; for it is not as man seeth; for man looketh upon the outward appearance, but Jehovah looketh upon the heart.

title: I Samuel 16:8
text: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither has Jehovah chosen this one.

title: I Samuel 16:9
text: Then Jesse made Shammah pass by. And he said, Neither has Jehovah chosen this one.

title: I Samuel 16:10
text: And Jesse made seven of his sons pass before Samuel. And Samuel said to Jesse, Jehovah has not chosen these.

title: I Samuel 16:11
text: And Samuel said to Jesse, Are these all the young men? And he said, There is yet the youngest remaining, and behold, he is feeding the sheep. And Samuel said to Jesse, Send and fetch him; for we will not sit at table till he come hither.

title: I Samuel 16:12
text: And he sent and brought him in. And he was ruddy, and besides of a lovely countenance and beautiful appearance. And Jehovah said, Arise, anoint him; for this is he.

title: I Samuel 16:13
text: And Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren. And the Spirit of Jehovah came upon David from that day forward. And Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.

title: I Samuel 16:14
text: ¶And the Spirit of Jehovah departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from Jehovah troubled him.

title: I Samuel 16:15
text: And Saul's servants said to him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubles thee.

title: I Samuel 16:16
text: Let our lord now speak; thy servants are before thee: they shall seek out a man, a skilful player on a harp; and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from God is upon thee, that he shall play with his hand, and thou shalt be well.

title: I Samuel 16:17
text: And Saul said to his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring him to me.

title: I Samuel 16:18
text: And one of the young men answered and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite, who is skilled in playing, and he is a valiant man and a man of war, and skilled in speech, and of good presence, and Jehovah is with him.

title: I Samuel 16:19
text: Then Saul sent messengers to Jesse and said, Send me David thy son, who is with the sheep.

title: I Samuel 16:20
text: And Jesse took an ass with bread, and a flask of wine, and a kid, and sent [them] by David his son to Saul.

title: I Samuel 16:21
text: And David came to Saul, and stood before him; and he loved him greatly; and he became his armour-bearer.

title: I Samuel 16:22
text: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he has found favour in my sight.

title: I Samuel 16:23
text: And it came to pass, when the [evil] spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took the harp, and played with his hand; and Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

title: I Samuel 17:1
text: ¶And the Philistines assembled their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Sochoh, which belongs to Judah, and encamped between Sochoh and Azekah, in Ephesdammim.

title: I Samuel 17:2
text: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and encamped in the valley of terebinths, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

title: I Samuel 17:3
text: And the Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on the mountain on the other side; and the ravine was between them.

title: I Samuel 17:4
text: And there went out a champion from the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.

title: I Samuel 17:5
text: And he had a helmet of bronze upon his head, and he was clothed with a corselet of scales; and the weight of the corselet was five thousand shekels of bronze.

title: I Samuel 17:6
text: And he had greaves of bronze upon his legs, and a javelin of bronze between his shoulders.

title: I Samuel 17:7
text: And the shaft of his spear was like a weaver's beam; and his spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron; and the shield-bearer went before him.

title: I Samuel 17:8
text: And he stood and cried to the ranks of Israel, and said to them, Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? am not I the Philistine, and ye servants of Saul? choose for yourselves a man, and let him come down to me.

title: I Samuel 17:9
text: If he be able to fight with me, and to smite me, then will we be your servants; but if I overcome and smite him, then shall ye be our servants and serve us.

title: I Samuel 17:10
text: And the Philistine said, I have defied the ranks of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.

title: I Samuel 17:11
text: And Saul and all Israel heard these words of the Philistine, and they were dismayed and greatly afraid.

title: I Samuel 17:12
text: ¶Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehem-Judah whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons; and the man was old in the days of Saul, advanced [in years] among men.

title: I Samuel 17:13
text: And the three eldest of the sons of Jesse had gone and followed Saul to the battle; and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and the second to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

title: I Samuel 17:14
text: And David was the youngest; and the three eldest had followed Saul.

title: I Samuel 17:15
text: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Bethlehem.

title: I Samuel 17:16
text: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

title: I Samuel 17:17
text: And Jesse said to David his son, Take, I pray, for thy brethren, this ephah of parched [corn] and these ten loaves, and carry them quickly to the camp to thy brethren;

title: I Samuel 17:18
text: and carry these ten cheeses to the captain of the thousand, and visit thy brethren to see how they are, and take a pledge of them.

title: I Samuel 17:19
text: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel [were] in the valley of terebinths, fighting against the Philistines.

title: I Samuel 17:20
text: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took his charge and went, as Jesse had commanded him. And he came to the wagon-defence; and the host which was going forth to the battle-array shouted for the fight.

title: I Samuel 17:21
text: And Israel and the Philistines put the battle in array, rank against rank.

title: I Samuel 17:22
text: And David left the things he was carrying in the hand of the keeper of the baggage, and ran into the ranks, and came and saluted his brethren.

title: I Samuel 17:23
text: And as he talked with them, behold there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the ranks of the Philistines, and spoke according to the same words; and David heard [them].

title: I Samuel 17:24
text: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him and were greatly afraid.

title: I Samuel 17:25
text: And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that comes up? for to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who smites him, him will the king enrich with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father's house free in Israel.

title: I Samuel 17:26
text: And David spoke to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that smites this Philistine, and takes away the reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?

title: I Samuel 17:27
text: And the people told him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that smites him.

title: I Samuel 17:28
text: And Eliab, his eldest brother, heard while he spoke to the men; and Eliab's anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why art thou come down? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride and the naughtiness of thy heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.

title: I Samuel 17:29
text: And David said, What have I now done? Was it not laid upon me?

title: I Samuel 17:30
text: And he turned from him to another, and spoke after the same manner; and the people answered him again after the former manner.

title: I Samuel 17:31
text: ¶And the words were heard which David spoke, and they rehearsed them before Saul; and he sent for him.

title: I Samuel 17:32
text: And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart fail because of him: thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.

title: I Samuel 17:33
text: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him; for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.

title: I Samuel 17:34
text: And David said to Saul, Thy servant fed his father's sheep, and there came a lion, and also a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock.

title: I Samuel 17:35
text: And I went after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth; and when he arose against me, I seized him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.

title: I Samuel 17:36
text: Thy servant smote both the lion and the bear; and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, because he has defied the armies of the living God.

title: I Samuel 17:37
text: And David said, Jehovah who delivered me out of the paw of the lion and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said to David, Go, and Jehovah be with thee.

title: I Samuel 17:38
text: And Saul clothed David with his dress, and put a helmet of bronze upon his head, and clothed him with a corselet.

title: I Samuel 17:39
text: And David girded his sword upon his dress, and endeavoured to go; for he had not yet tried [it]. And David said to Saul, I cannot go in these; for I have never tried [them]. And David put them off him.

title: I Samuel 17:40
text: ¶And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in the shepherd's bag that he had, into the pocket; and his sling was in his hand. And he drew near to the Philistine.

title: I Samuel 17:41
text: And the Philistine came on and approached David; and the man that bore the shield was before him.

title: I Samuel 17:42
text: And when the Philistine looked about and saw David, he disdained him; for he was a youth, and ruddy, and besides of a beautiful countenance.

title: I Samuel 17:43
text: And the Philistine said to David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

title: I Samuel 17:44
text: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh to the fowls of the heavens and to the beasts of the field.

title: I Samuel 17:45
text: And David said to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with sword, and with spear, and with javelin; but I come to thee in the name of Jehovah of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.

title: I Samuel 17:46
text: This day will Jehovah deliver thee up into my hand; and I will smite thee, and take thy head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the camp of the Philistines this day to the fowl of the heavens and to the wild beasts of the earth. And all the earth shall know that Israel has a God;

title: I Samuel 17:47
text: and all this congregation shall know that Jehovah saves not with sword and spear; for the battle is Jehovah's, and he will give you into our hands.

title: I Samuel 17:48
text: ¶And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and advanced to meet David, that David hasted, and ran towards the ranks to meet the Philistine.

title: I Samuel 17:49
text: And David put his hand into the bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, and the stone sank into his forehead; and he fell on his face to the earth.

title: I Samuel 17:50
text: So David overcame the Philistine with a sling and a stone, and smote the Philistine and killed him; and there was no sword in the hand of David.

title: I Samuel 17:51
text: And David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of its sheath, and killed him completely, and cut off his head with it. And when the Philistines saw that their hero was dead, they fled.

title: I Samuel 17:52
text: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou comest to the ravine and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down on the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath, and to Ekron.

title: I Samuel 17:53
text: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they pillaged their camps.

title: I Samuel 17:54
text: And David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.

title: I Samuel 17:55
text: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son is this young man? And Abner said, As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.

title: I Samuel 17:56
text: And the king said, Inquire thou whose son this youth is.

title: I Samuel 17:57
text: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

title: I Samuel 17:58
text: And Saul said to him, Whose son art thou, young man? And David said, I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Beth-lehemite.

title: I Samuel 18:1
text: ¶And it came to pass, when he had ended speaking to Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

title: I Samuel 18:2
text: And Saul took him that day, and would not let him return to his father's house.

title: I Samuel 18:3
text: And Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

title: I Samuel 18:4
text: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his dress, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.

title: I Samuel 18:5
text: And David went forth; whithersoever Saul sent him he prospered; and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.

title: I Samuel 18:6
text: ¶And it came to pass as they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tambours, with joy, and with triangles.

title: I Samuel 18:7
text: And the women answered [one another] as they played, and said, Saul hath smitten his thousands, And David his ten thousands.

title: I Samuel 18:8
text: And Saul was very wroth, and that saying was evil in his sight; and he said, They have ascribed to David ten thousands, but to me they have ascribed the thousands; and [what] is there more for him but the kingdom?

title: I Samuel 18:9
text: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.

title: I Samuel 18:10
text: And it came to pass the next day that an evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house, but David played with his hand, as on other days; and the spear was in Saul's hand.

title: I Samuel 18:11
text: And Saul cast the spear, and thought, I will smite David and the wall. But David turned away from him twice.

title: I Samuel 18:12
text: ¶And Saul was afraid of David, because Jehovah was with him, and had departed from Saul.

title: I Samuel 18:13
text: And Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

title: I Samuel 18:14
text: And David prospered in all his ways; and Jehovah was with him.

title: I Samuel 18:15
text: And Saul saw that he prospered well, and he stood in awe of him.

title: I Samuel 18:16
text: But all Israel and Judah loved David, for he went out and came in before them.

title: I Samuel 18:17
text: And Saul said to David, Behold my eldest daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife; only be thou valiant for me, and fight Jehovah's battles. But Saul thought, My hand shall not be upon him, but the hand of the Philistines shall be upon him.

title: I Samuel 18:18
text: And David said to Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, [or] my father's family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?

title: I Samuel 18:19
text: And it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul's daughter should have been given to David, that she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.

title: I Samuel 18:20
text: And Michal Saul's daughter loved David; and they told Saul, and the thing was right in his sight.

title: I Samuel 18:21
text: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be upon him. And Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son-in-law a second time.

title: I Samuel 18:22
text: And Saul commanded his servants, Speak with David secretly, saying, Behold, the king has delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king's son-in-law.

title: I Samuel 18:23
text: And Saul's servants spoke those words in the ears of David. And David said, Is it a light thing in your eyes to be the king's son-in-law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?

title: I Samuel 18:24
text: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner did David speak.

title: I Samuel 18:25
text: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David: The king does not desire any dowry, but a hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king's enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

title: I Samuel 18:26
text: And his servants told David these words; and the thing was right in David's sight to be the king's son-in-law. And the days were not expired,

title: I Samuel 18:27
text: when David arose and went, he and his men, and smote of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they delivered them in full to the king, that he might be the king's son-in-law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter as wife.

title: I Samuel 18:28
text: And Saul saw and knew that Jehovah was with David; and Michal Saul's daughter loved him.

title: I Samuel 18:29
text: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul was David's enemy continually.

title: I Samuel 18:30
text: And the princes of the Philistines went forth; and it came to pass, whenever they went forth, that David succeeded better than all the servants of Saul; and his name was much esteemed.

title: I Samuel 19:1
text: ¶And Saul spoke to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should slay David.

title: I Samuel 19:2
text: But Jonathan Saul's son delighted much in David. And Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeks to kill thee; and now, I pray thee, take heed to thyself in the morning, and abide in a secret place and hide thyself;

title: I Samuel 19:3
text: and I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and will speak of thee with my father: and see what it is, and tell thee.

title: I Samuel 19:4
text: And Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David, because he has not sinned against thee; for also what he did was very advantageous to thee;

title: I Samuel 19:5
text: for he put his life in hand, and smote the Philistine, and Jehovah wrought a great salvation for all Israel: thou didst see [it], and didst rejoice; why then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, in slaying David without cause?

title: I Samuel 19:6
text: And Saul hearkened to the voice of Jonathan, and Saul swore, [As] Jehovah liveth, he shall not be put to death!

title: I Samuel 19:7
text: Then Jonathan called David, and Jonathan declared to him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as previously.

title: I Samuel 19:8
text: ¶And there was war again; and David went forth and fought with the Philistines, and smote them with a great slaughter; and they fled before him.

title: I Samuel 19:9
text: And an evil spirit from Jehovah was upon Saul. And he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David played with his hand.

title: I Samuel 19:10
text: And Saul sought to smite David and the wall with the spear; but he slipped away out of Saul's presence, and he smote the spear into the wall. And David fled, and escaped that night.

title: I Samuel 19:11
text: ¶And Saul sent messengers to David's house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning; and Michal David's wife told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to-night, to-morrow thou wilt be put to death.

title: I Samuel 19:12
text: And Michal let David down through a window; and he went, and fled and escaped.

title: I Samuel 19:13
text: And Michal took the image, and laid it in the bed, and put the net of goats' [hair] at its head, and covered it with the coverlet.

title: I Samuel 19:14
text: And Saul sent messengers to take David, and she said, He is sick.

title: I Samuel 19:15
text: And Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may put him to death.

title: I Samuel 19:16
text: And the messengers came in, and behold, the image was in the bed, and the net of goats' [hair] at its head.

title: I Samuel 19:17
text: Then Saul said to Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away mine enemy, that he is escaped? And Michal said to Saul, He said to me, Let me go; why should I slay thee?

title: I Samuel 19:18
text: ¶And David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.

title: I Samuel 19:19
text: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth by Ramah.

title: I Samuel 19:20
text: Then Saul sent messengers to take David; and they saw a company of prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as president over them; and the Spirit of God came upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.

title: I Samuel 19:21
text: And it was told Saul, and he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.

title: I Samuel 19:22
text: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Sechu; and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, at Naioth by Ramah.

title: I Samuel 19:23
text: And he went thither to Naioth by Ramah; and the Spirit of God came upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth by Ramah.

title: I Samuel 19:24
text: And he himself also stripped off his clothes, and prophesied, himself also, before Samuel, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?

title: I Samuel 20:1
text: ¶And David fled from Naioth by Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity, and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeks my life?

title: I Samuel 20:2
text: And he said to him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, and not apprise me; and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.

title: I Samuel 20:3
text: And David swore again and again, and said, Thy father certainly knows that I have found favour in thy sight: and he has thought, Jonathan shall not know this, lest he be grieved; but truly [as] Jehovah liveth, and [as] thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.

title: I Samuel 20:4
text: And Jonathan said to David, What thy soul may say, I will even do it for thee.

title: I Samuel 20:5
text: And David said to Jonathan, Behold, to-morrow is new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat; but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field until the third evening.

title: I Samuel 20:6
text: If thy father should actually miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem his city; for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.

title: I Samuel 20:7
text: If he say thus, It is well, --thy servant shall have peace; but if he be very wroth, be sure that evil is determined by him.

title: I Samuel 20:8
text: Deal kindly then with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of Jehovah with thee; but if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?

title: I Samuel 20:9
text: ¶And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee; for, if I knew with certainty that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, would I not tell it thee?

title: I Samuel 20:10
text: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?

title: I Samuel 20:11
text: And Jonathan said to David, Come and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.

title: I Samuel 20:12
text: And Jonathan said to David, Jehovah, God of Israel, when I sound my father about this time to-morrow, [or] the next day, and behold, there be good toward David, and I then send not to thee, and apprise thee of it,

title: I Samuel 20:13
text: Jehovah do so and much more to Jonathan. Should it please my father [to do] thee evil, then I will apprise thee of it, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace; and Jehovah be with thee, as he has been with my father.

title: I Samuel 20:14
text: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of Jehovah, that I die not,

title: I Samuel 20:15
text: but thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever, no, not when Jehovah cuts off the enemies of David, every one from the face of the earth.

title: I Samuel 20:16
text: And Jonathan made [a covenant] with the house of David, [saying,] Let Jehovah even require [it] at the hand of David's enemies!

title: I Samuel 20:17
text: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, by the love he had for him, for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

title: I Samuel 20:18
text: And Jonathan said to him, To-morrow is the new moon; and thou wilt be missed, for thy seat will be empty;

title: I Samuel 20:19
text: but on the third day thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself on the day of the business, and abide by the stone Ezel.

title: I Samuel 20:20
text: And I will shoot three arrows on the side of it, as though I shot at a mark.

title: I Samuel 20:21
text: And behold, I will send the lad, [saying,] Go, find the arrows. If I expressly say to the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come, for there is peace for thee, and it is nothing; [as] Jehovah liveth.

title: I Samuel 20:22
text: But if I say thus to the youth: Behold, the arrows are beyond thee, --go thy way; for Jehovah sends thee away.

title: I Samuel 20:23
text: And as to the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, Jehovah is between me and thee for ever.

title: I Samuel 20:24
text: ¶And David hid himself in the field; and it was the new moon, and the king sat at table to eat.

title: I Samuel 20:25
text: And the king sat on his seat, as at other times, on the seat by the wall; and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul's side, and David's place was empty.

title: I Samuel 20:26
text: And Saul said nothing that day; for he thought, Something has befallen [him], that he is not clean: surely he is not clean.

title: I Samuel 20:27
text: And it came to pass the next day after the new moon, the second [day of the month], as David's place was empty, that Saul said to Jonathan his son, Why has not the son of Jesse come to table, neither yesterday nor to-day?

title: I Samuel 20:28
text: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me [to go] to Bethlehem,

title: I Samuel 20:29
text: and said, Let me go, I pray thee; for we have a family sacrifice in the city; and my brother himself has commanded me [to be there]; and now, if I have found favour in thy sight, let me go away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. He has therefore not come to the king's table.

title: I Samuel 20:30
text: And Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said to him, Son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own shame and to the shame of thy mother's nakedness?

title: I Samuel 20:31
text: For as long as the son of Jesse lives upon earth, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. And now send and fetch him to me, for he must die.

title: I Samuel 20:32
text: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, Why should he be put to death? what has he done?

title: I Samuel 20:33
text: Then Saul cast the spear at him to smite him; and Jonathan knew that it was determined by his father to put David to death.

title: I Samuel 20:34
text: And Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no meat the second day of the new moon; for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.

title: I Samuel 20:35
text: ¶And it came to pass in the morning that Jonathan went out into the field, to the place agreed on with David, and a little lad with him.

title: I Samuel 20:36
text: And he said to his lad, Run, find now the arrows which I shoot. The lad ran, and he shot the arrow beyond him.

title: I Samuel 20:37
text: And when the lad came to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad and said, Is not the arrow away beyond thee?

title: I Samuel 20:38
text: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not! And Jonathan's lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

title: I Samuel 20:39
text: And the lad knew nothing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

title: I Samuel 20:40
text: And Jonathan gave his weapons to his lad, and said to him, Go, carry them to the city.

title: I Samuel 20:41
text: The lad went, and David arose from the side of the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times; and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.

title: I Samuel 20:42
text: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have both of us sworn in the name of Jehovah, saying, Jehovah be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever! And he arose and departed; and Jonathan went into the city.

title: I Samuel 21:1
text: ¶And David came to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest; and Ahimelech trembled at meeting David, and said to him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?

title: I Samuel 21:2
text: And David said to Ahimelech the priest, The king has commanded me a business, and has said to me, Let no man know anything of the business whereon I send thee, and what I have commanded thee; and I have directed the young men to such and such a place.

title: I Samuel 21:3
text: And now what is under thy hand? give me five loaves in my hand, or what may be found.

title: I Samuel 21:4
text: And the priest answered David and said, There is no common bread under my hand, but there is holy bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.

title: I Samuel 21:5
text: And David answered the priest and said to him, Yes indeed, women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the [bread] is in a manner common, and the more so, because to-day [new] is hallowed in the vessels.

title: I Samuel 21:6
text: And the priest gave him holy [bread]; for there was no bread there but the shew-loaves that were taken from before Jehovah, to put on hot bread in the day when they were taken away.

title: I Samuel 21:7
text: (Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before Jehovah; and his name was Doeg, the Edomite, chief of the shepherds that [belonged] to Saul.)

title: I Samuel 21:8
text: And David said to Ahimelech, And is there not here under thy hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, for the king's business was urgent.

title: I Samuel 21:9
text: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the valley of terebinths, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod; if thou wilt take that, take it; for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that: give it me.

title: I Samuel 21:10
text: ¶And David arose, and fled that day from before Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

title: I Samuel 21:11
text: And the servants of Achish said to him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul has smitten his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

title: I Samuel 21:12
text: And David took to heart these words, and was much afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

title: I Samuel 21:13
text: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scratched on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down on his beard.

title: I Samuel 21:14
text: And Achish said to his servants, Behold, ye see the man is mad: why did ye bring him to me?

title: I Samuel 21:15
text: have I lack of madmen, that ye have brought this one to rave in my presence? shall this [man] come into my house?

title: I Samuel 22:1
text: ¶And David departed thence, and escaped to the cave of Adullam. And his brethren and all his father's house heard [it], and they went down thither to him.

title: I Samuel 22:2
text: And every one in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one of embittered spirit collected round him; and he became a captain over them; and there were with him about four hundred men.

title: I Samuel 22:3
text: And David went thence to Mizpeh in Moab, and said to the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth amongst you, till I know what God will do for me.

title: I Samuel 22:4
text: And he brought them before the king of Moab; and they abode with him all the while that David was in the stronghold.

title: I Samuel 22:5
text: And the prophet Gad said to David, Abide not in the stronghold; depart, and go into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.

title: I Samuel 22:6
text: ¶And Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him. Now Saul was sitting in Gibeah under the tamarisk upon the height, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing by him.

title: I Samuel 22:7
text: Then Saul said to his servants that stood by him, Hear now, ye Benjaminites: will the son of Jesse give every one of you also fields and vineyards? Will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds,

title: I Samuel 22:8
text: that all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that informs me when my son has made [a covenant] with the son of Jesse; and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or informs me that my son has stirred up my servant as a lier-in-wait against me, as at this day?

title: I Samuel 22:9
text: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, who was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

title: I Samuel 22:10
text: And he inquired of Jehovah for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

title: I Samuel 22:11
text: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father's house, the priests that were in Nob; and they came all of them to the king.

title: I Samuel 22:12
text: And Saul said, Hear now, son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.

title: I Samuel 22:13
text: And Saul said to him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me as a lier-in-wait, as at this day?

title: I Samuel 22:14
text: And Ahimelech answered the king and said, And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, who is the king's son-in-law, and has access to thy secret council, and is honourable in thy house?

title: I Samuel 22:15
text: Was it to-day that I began to inquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king charge anything to his servant, [nor] to all the house of my father; for thy servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.

title: I Samuel 22:16
text: And the king said, Thou shalt certainly die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father's house.

title: I Samuel 22:17
text: And the king said to the couriers that stood about him, Turn and put the priests of Jehovah to death; because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not inform me. But the servants of the king were not willing to put forth their hand to fall on the priests of Jehovah.

title: I Samuel 22:18
text: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall on the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and fell on the priests, and put to death that day eighty-five persons who wore the linen ephod.

title: I Samuel 22:19
text: And Nob, the city of the priests, he smote with the edge of the sword, both men and women, infants and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

title: I Samuel 22:20
text: ¶And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.

title: I Samuel 22:21
text: And Abiathar informed David that Saul had slain Jehovah's priests.

title: I Samuel 22:22
text: And David said to Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would certainly tell Saul: I am accountable for all the lives of thy father's house.

title: I Samuel 22:23
text: Abide with me, fear not; for he that seeks my life seeks thy life; for with me thou art in safe keeping.

title: I Samuel 23:1
text: ¶And they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshing-floors.

title: I Samuel 23:2
text: And David inquired of Jehovah, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And Jehovah said to David, Go and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.

title: I Samuel 23:3
text: But David's men said to him, Behold, we are afraid here in Judah; how much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?

title: I Samuel 23:4
text: And David inquired of Jehovah yet again. And Jehovah answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will give the Philistines into thy hand.

title: I Samuel 23:5
text: And David and his men went to Keilah, and fought against the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

title: I Samuel 23:6
text: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, he came down with an ephod in his hand.

title: I Samuel 23:7
text: ¶And it was told Saul that David had come to Keilah. Then Saul said, God has cast him off into my hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a city that has gates and bars.

title: I Samuel 23:8
text: And Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.

title: I Samuel 23:9
text: And when David knew that Saul devised mischief against him, he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring the ephod.

title: I Samuel 23:10
text: Then said David, Jehovah, God of Israel, thy servant hath heard for certain that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.

title: I Samuel 23:11
text: Will the citizens of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? Jehovah, God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And Jehovah said, He will come down.

title: I Samuel 23:12
text: And David said, Will the citizens of Keilah deliver up me and my men into the hand of Saul? And Jehovah said, They will deliver [thee] up.

title: I Samuel 23:13
text: Then David and his men, about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David had escaped from Keilah, and he forbore to go forth.

title: I Samuel 23:14
text: ¶And David abode in the wilderness in strongholds, and abode in the mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God did not give him into his hand.

title: I Samuel 23:15
text: And David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life; and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.

title: I Samuel 23:16
text: And Jonathan Saul's son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.

title: I Samuel 23:17
text: And he said to him, Fear not; for the hand of Saul my father will not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next to thee; and that also Saul my father knows.

title: I Samuel 23:18
text: And they two made a covenant before Jehovah; and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.

title: I Samuel 23:19
text: ¶And the Ziphites came up to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Does not David hide himself with us in strongholds in the wood, on the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of the waste?

title: I Samuel 23:20
text: And now, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and it will be for us to deliver him up into the king's hand.

title: I Samuel 23:21
text: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of Jehovah; for ye have compassion upon me.

title: I Samuel 23:22
text: Go, I pray you, make yet more sure, and know and see his place where his track is, who has seen him there; for it is told me that he deals very subtilly.

title: I Samuel 23:23
text: And see, and ascertain all the lurking-places where he hides himself, and come ye again to me with sure information, that I may go with you; and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout the thousands of Judah.

title: I Samuel 23:24
text: And they arose and went to Ziph before Saul; but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of the waste.

title: I Samuel 23:25
text: And Saul and his men went to seek [him]. And they told David; and he came down from the rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And Saul heard [that], and he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.

title: I Samuel 23:26
text: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain; and David made haste to get away from Saul; and Saul and his men sought to surround David and his men to take them.

title: I Samuel 23:27
text: But there came a messenger to Saul, saying, Haste thee and come; for the Philistines have made a raid against the land.

title: I Samuel 23:28
text: And Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines; therefore they called that place Sela-hammahlekoth.

title: I Samuel 23:29
text: And David went up from thence, and abode in the strongholds of Engedi.

title: I Samuel 24:1
text: ¶And it came to pass when Saul had returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of Engedi.

title: I Samuel 24:2
text: And Saul took three thousand men, chosen out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.

title: I Samuel 24:3
text: And he came to the sheepfolds by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet; and David and his men were abiding in the recesses of the cave.

title: I Samuel 24:4
text: And David's men said to him, Behold the day of which Jehovah said to thee, Behold, I will give thine enemy into thy hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good to thee. And David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe secretly.

title: I Samuel 24:5
text: And it came to pass afterwards that David's heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul's skirt.

title: I Samuel 24:6
text: And he said to his men, Jehovah forbid that I should do this thing to my master, Jehovah's anointed, to stretch forth my hand against him, for he is the anointed of Jehovah.

title: I Samuel 24:7
text: And David checked his men with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. And Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on [his] way.

title: I Samuel 24:8
text: David also arose afterwards, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king! And when Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and did obeisance.

title: I Samuel 24:9
text: ¶And David said to Saul, Why dost thou listen to words of men, saying, Behold, David seeks thy hurt?

title: I Samuel 24:10
text: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that Jehovah had given thee this day into my hand in the cave; and they bade me kill thee; but [mine eye] spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth my hand against my lord, for he is the anointed of Jehovah.

title: I Samuel 24:11
text: And see, my father, yes, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand. For in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in my hand, and I have not sinned against thee; yet thou liest in wait for my life to take it.

title: I Samuel 24:12
text: Jehovah judge between me and thee, and Jehovah avenge me of thee; but my hand shall not be upon thee.

title: I Samuel 24:13
text: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked; but my hand shall not be upon thee.

title: I Samuel 24:14
text: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a single flea.

title: I Samuel 24:15
text: Jehovah therefore shall be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and do me justice [in delivering me] out of thy hand.

title: I Samuel 24:16
text: ¶And as soon as David had ended speaking these words to Saul, Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice and wept.

title: I Samuel 24:17
text: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I; for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.

title: I Samuel 24:18
text: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me, forasmuch as when Jehovah had delivered me up into thy hand, thou didst not kill me.

title: I Samuel 24:19
text: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore Jehovah reward thee good for that thou hast done to me this day.

title: I Samuel 24:20
