text: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.

title: I Kings 12:30
text: And this thing became a sin; and the people went [to worship] before the one, as far as Dan.

title: I Kings 12:31
text: And he made a house of high places, and made priests from all classes of the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.

title: I Kings 12:32
text: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that was in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made; and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.

title: I Kings 12:33
text: And he offered upon the altar that he had made in Bethel, on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and he made a feast for the children of Israel, and he offered upon the altar, burning incense.

title: I Kings 13:1
text: ¶And behold, there came a man of God from Judah, by the word of Jehovah, to Bethel; and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.

title: I Kings 13:2
text: And he cried against the altar by the word of Jehovah, and said, O altar, altar! thus saith Jehovah: Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he sacrifice the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men's bones shall be burned upon thee.

title: I Kings 13:3
text: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign that Jehovah hath spoken: Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.

title: I Kings 13:4
text: And it came to pass when the king heard the word of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, that Jeroboam stretched forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand which he stretched out against him dried up, so that he could not bring it back again to him.

title: I Kings 13:5
text: And the altar was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign that the man of God had given by the word of Jehovah.

title: I Kings 13:6
text: And the king answered and said to the man of God, Intreat now Jehovah thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored to me again. And the man of God intreated Jehovah, and the king's hand was restored to him again, and became as before.

title: I Kings 13:7
text: And the king said to the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a present.

title: I Kings 13:8
text: And the man of God said to the king, If thou wilt give me half thy house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place;

title: I Kings 13:9
text: for so was it charged me by the word of Jehovah, saying, Thou shalt eat no bread, nor drink water, nor return by the way that thou shalt go.

title: I Kings 13:10
text: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he had come to Bethel.

title: I Kings 13:11
text: ¶Now there dwelt a certain old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel; the words that he had spoken to the king, them they told also to their father.

title: I Kings 13:12
text: And their father said to them, Which way went he? for his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.

title: I Kings 13:13
text: And he said to his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass; and he rode thereon,

title: I Kings 13:14
text: and went after the man of God, and found him sitting under a terebinth; and he said to him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.

title: I Kings 13:15
text: And he said to him, Come home with me, and eat bread.

title: I Kings 13:16
text: And he said, I cannot return with thee, nor go in with thee; neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place.

title: I Kings 13:17
text: For it was said to me by the word of Jehovah, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou wentest.

title: I Kings 13:18
text: And he said to him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spoke to me by the word of Jehovah saying, Bring him back with thee into thy house, that he may eat bread and drink water. He lied unto him.

title: I Kings 13:19
text: Then he went back with him, and ate bread in his house, and drank water.

title: I Kings 13:20
text: And it came to pass as they sat at the table, that the word of Jehovah came to the prophet that brought him back;

title: I Kings 13:21
text: and he cried to the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith Jehovah: Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the word of Jehovah, and hast not kept the commandment that Jehovah thy God commanded thee,

title: I Kings 13:22
text: but camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place of which he said to thee, Eat no bread and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come to the sepulchre of thy fathers.

title: I Kings 13:23
text: ¶And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled the ass for him, for the prophet that he had brought back;

title: I Kings 13:24
text: and he departed. And a lion met him by the way and slew him; and his corpse was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it; the lion also stood by the corpse.

title: I Kings 13:25
text: And behold, men passed by, and saw the corpse cast in the way and the lion standing by the corpse; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.

title: I Kings 13:26
text: And the prophet that brought him back from the way heard [of it] and said, It is the man of God who was disobedient to the word of Jehovah; therefore Jehovah has delivered him to the lion, which has torn him and slain him, according to the word of Jehovah which he spoke to him.

title: I Kings 13:27
text: And he spoke to his sons saying, Saddle me the ass; and they saddled it.

title: I Kings 13:28
text: And he went and found his corpse cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the corpse: the lion had not eaten the corpse, nor torn the ass.

title: I Kings 13:29
text: And the prophet took up the corpse of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back; and the old prophet came into the city, to mourn and to bury him.

title: I Kings 13:30
text: And he laid his corpse in his own sepulchre; and they mourned over him [saying], Alas, my brother!

title: I Kings 13:31
text: And it came to pass after he had buried him, that he spoke to his sons saying, When I am dead, bury me in the sepulchre in which the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.

title: I Kings 13:32
text: For the word that he cried by the word of Jehovah against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places that are in the cities of Samaria, shall certainly come to pass.

title: I Kings 13:33
text: After this thing Jeroboam turned not from his evil way, but made again from all classes of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became [one] of the priests of the high places.

title: I Kings 13:34
text: And by this thing there was sin on the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.

title: I Kings 14:1
text: ¶At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam was sick.

title: I Kings 14:2
text: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and go to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, who told me that [I should be] king over this people.

title: I Kings 14:3
text: And take with thee ten loaves, and cakes, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he will tell thee what shall become of the lad.

title: I Kings 14:4
text: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. And Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

title: I Kings 14:5
text: And Jehovah said to Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee about her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her; for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign to be another.

title: I Kings 14:6
text: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou to be another? But I am sent to thee with a hard [message].

title: I Kings 14:7
text: ¶Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith Jehovah the God of Israel: Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,

title: I Kings 14:8
text: and rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee; and thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do only that which is right in my sight;

title: I Kings 14:9
text: but thou hast done evil above all that were before thee, and hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:

title: I Kings 14:10
text: therefore behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam every male, him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.

title: I Kings 14:11
text: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat, and him that dieth in the field shall the fowl of the heavens eat; for Jehovah hath spoken.

title: I Kings 14:12
text: And thou, arise, go to thine own house; when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.

title: I Kings 14:13
text: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and they shall bury him; for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found something good toward Jehovah the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.

title: I Kings 14:14
text: And Jehovah shall raise up for himself a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day; and what? ...even now.

title: I Kings 14:15
text: And Jehovah will smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he will root up Israel out of this good land which he gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their Asherahs, provoking Jehovah to anger.

title: I Kings 14:16
text: And he will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, wherewith he has sinned, and made Israel to sin.

title: I Kings 14:17
text: And Jeroboam's wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah; when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died.

title: I Kings 14:18
text: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of Jehovah, which he spoke through his servant Ahijah the prophet.

title: I Kings 14:19
text: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

title: I Kings 14:20
text: And the days that Jeroboam reigned were twenty-two years; and he slept with his fathers. And Nadab his son reigned in his stead.

title: I Kings 14:21
text: ¶And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city that Jehovah had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there; and his mother's name was Naamah, an Ammonitess.

title: I Kings 14:22
text: And Judah did evil in the sight of Jehovah, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed more than all that their fathers had done.

title: I Kings 14:23
text: And they also built for themselves high places, and columns, and Asherahs on every high hill and under every green tree;

title: I Kings 14:24
text: and there were also sodomites in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations that Jehovah had dispossessed before the children of Israel.

title: I Kings 14:25
text: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, [that] Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem.

title: I Kings 14:26
text: And he took away the treasures of the house of Jehovah, and the treasures of the king's house; he even took away all; and he took away all the shields of gold that Solomon had made.

title: I Kings 14:27
text: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brazen shields, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the couriers who kept the entrance of the king's house.

title: I Kings 14:28
text: And it was so, that as often as the king entered into the house of Jehovah, the couriers bore them, and brought them again into the chamber of the couriers.

title: I Kings 14:29
text: And the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

title: I Kings 14:30
text: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all [their] days.

title: I Kings 14:31
text: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother's name was Naamah, an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.

title: I Kings 15:1
text: ¶And in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat began Abijam to reign over Judah.

title: I Kings 15:2
text: He reigned three years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Maachah, a daughter of Abishalom.

title: I Kings 15:3
text: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; and his heart was not perfect with Jehovah his God, as the heart of David his father.

title: I Kings 15:4
text: But for David's sake Jehovah his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, setting up his son after him, and establishing Jerusalem;

title: I Kings 15:5
text: because David did that which was right in the sight of Jehovah, and turned not aside from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, except in the matter of Urijah the Hittite.

title: I Kings 15:6
text: And there had been war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

title: I Kings 15:7
text: And the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

title: I Kings 15:8
text: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David. And Asa his son reigned in his stead.

title: I Kings 15:9
text: ¶And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah;

title: I Kings 15:10
text: and he reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Maachah, daughter of Abishalom.

title: I Kings 15:11
text: And Asa did what was right in the sight of Jehovah, as David his father.

title: I Kings 15:12
text: And he put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his father had made.

title: I Kings 15:13
text: And also Maachah his mother he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol for the Asherah; and Asa cut down her idol, and burned it in the valley of Kidron.

title: I Kings 15:14
text: But the high places were not removed; only, Asa's heart was perfect with Jehovah all his days.

title: I Kings 15:15
text: And he brought into the house of Jehovah the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which he himself had dedicated, silver and gold and vessels.

title: I Kings 15:16
text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

title: I Kings 15:17
text: And Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, in order to let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

title: I Kings 15:18
text: And Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of Jehovah, and in the treasures of the king's house, and gave them into the hand of his servants; and king Asa sent them to Ben-Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who dwelt at Damascus, saying,

title: I Kings 15:19
text: There is a league between me and thee, [as] between my father and thy father; behold, I send thee a present of silver and gold: go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

title: I Kings 15:20
text: And Ben-Hadad hearkened to king Asa, and sent the captains of his forces against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-Beth-Maachah, and all Kinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

title: I Kings 15:21
text: And it came to pass when Baasha heard of it, that he left off building Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.

title: I Kings 15:22
text: And king Asa called together all Judah: none was exempted; and they carried away the stones and the timber from Ramah, with which Baasha had been building; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

title: I Kings 15:23
text: And the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Only, in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

title: I Kings 15:24
text: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father. And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.

title: I Kings 15:25
text: ¶And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.

title: I Kings 15:26
text: And he did evil in the sight of Jehovah, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin with which he made Israel sin.

title: I Kings 15:27
text: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which [belonged] to the Philistines, when Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.

title: I Kings 15:28
text: And Baasha slew him in the third year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.

title: I Kings 15:29
text: And it came to pass when he was king, he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left to Jeroboam none that breathed; until he had destroyed him, according to the word of Jehovah which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite,

title: I Kings 15:30
text: because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and wherewith he made Israel to sin; by his provocation with which he provoked Jehovah the God of Israel to anger.

title: I Kings 15:31
text: And the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

title: I Kings 15:32
text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

title: I Kings 15:33
text: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, for twenty-four years.

title: I Kings 15:34
text: And he did evil in the sight of Jehovah, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin where with he made Israel to sin.

title: I Kings 16:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

title: I Kings 16:2
text: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel, and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, provoking me to anger with their sins;

title: I Kings 16:3
text: behold, I will take away Baasha and his house, and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

title: I Kings 16:4
text: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat, and him that dieth of his in the field shall the fowl of the heavens eat.

title: I Kings 16:5
text: And the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

title: I Kings 16:6
text: And Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his stead.

title: I Kings 16:7
text: And also through the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani the word of Jehovah came against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of Jehovah, provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he had smitten him.

title: I Kings 16:8
text: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years.

title: I Kings 16:9
text: And his servant Zimri, captain of half [his] chariots, conspired against him; and he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was the steward of his house in Tirzah;

title: I Kings 16:10
text: and Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned in his stead.

title: I Kings 16:11
text: And it came to pass when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not a male, neither of his kinsmen nor of his friends.

title: I Kings 16:12
text: And Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the word of Jehovah, which he spoke against Baasha through Jehu the prophet,

title: I Kings 16:13
text: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and wherewith they made Israel to sin, provoking Jehovah the God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

title: I Kings 16:14
text: And the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

title: I Kings 16:15
text: ¶In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which [belonged] to the Philistines.

title: I Kings 16:16
text: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri has conspired, and has also smitten the king; and all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.

title: I Kings 16:17
text: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

title: I Kings 16:18
text: And it came to pass when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the citadel of the king's house, and burned the king's house over him with fire;

title: I Kings 16:19
text: and he died for his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of Jehovah, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, making Israel to sin.

title: I Kings 16:20
text: And the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his conspiracy which he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

title: I Kings 16:21
text: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.

title: I Kings 16:22
text: But the people that followed Omri overcame the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath; and Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

title: I Kings 16:23
text: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel, --twelve years; he reigned six years in Tirzah.

title: I Kings 16:24
text: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and built on the hill, and called the name of the city that he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.

title: I Kings 16:25
text: And Omri wrought evil in the sight of Jehovah, and did worse than all that were before him.

title: I Kings 16:26
text: And he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins wherewith he made Israel to sin, provoking Jehovah the God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

title: I Kings 16:27
text: And the rest of the acts of Omri, what he did, and his might which he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

title: I Kings 16:28
text: And Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.

title: I Kings 16:29
text: ¶And Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah; and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

title: I Kings 16:30
text: And Ahab the son of Omri wrought evil in the sight of Jehovah more than all that were before him.

title: I Kings 16:31
text: And it came to pass, as if it was a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians; and he went and served Baal and worshipped him.

title: I Kings 16:32
text: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he built in Samaria.

title: I Kings 16:33
text: And Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more to provoke Jehovah the God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.

title: I Kings 16:34
text: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho; he laid its foundation in Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates in Segub his youngest, according to the word of Jehovah which he spoke through Joshua the son of Nun.

title: I Kings 17:1
text: ¶And Elijah the Tishbite, of the inhabitants of Gilead, said to Ahab, As Jehovah the God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, except by my word.

title: I Kings 17:2
text: And the word of Jehovah came to him saying,

title: I Kings 17:3
text: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the torrent Cherith, which is before the Jordan.

title: I Kings 17:4
text: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the torrent; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.

title: I Kings 17:5
text: And he went and did according to the word of Jehovah; he went and abode by the torrent Cherith, which is before the Jordan.

title: I Kings 17:6
text: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the torrent.

title: I Kings 17:7
text: And it came to pass after a while that the torrent dried up, for there had been no rain in the land.

title: I Kings 17:8
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came to him saying,

title: I Kings 17:9
text: Arise, go to Zarephath, which is by Zidon, and abide there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to maintain thee.

title: I Kings 17:10
text: And he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the entrance of the city, behold, a widow woman was there gathering sticks. And he called to her and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

title: I Kings 17:11
text: And she went to fetch [it], and he called to her and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thy hand.

title: I Kings 17:12
text: And she said, As Jehovah thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but a handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse; and behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.

title: I Kings 17:13
text: And Elijah said to her, Fear not; go, do as thou hast said; but make me thereof a little cake first; and bring it to me; and afterwards make for thee and for thy son.

title: I Kings 17:14
text: For thus saith Jehovah the God of Israel: The meal in the barrel shall not waste, neither shall the oil in the cruse fail, until the day that Jehovah sendeth rain upon the face of the earth!

title: I Kings 17:15
text: And she went and did according to the word of Elijah; and she, and he, and her house, ate a whole year.

title: I Kings 17:16
text: The meal in the barrel did not waste, neither did the oil in the cruse fail, according to the word of Jehovah which he had spoken through Elijah.

title: I Kings 17:17
text: ¶And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.

title: I Kings 17:18
text: And she said to Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come to me to call mine iniquity to remembrance, and to slay my son?

title: I Kings 17:19
text: And he said to her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the upper chamber where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.

title: I Kings 17:20
text: And he cried to Jehovah and said, Jehovah, my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?

title: I Kings 17:21
text: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried to Jehovah and said, Jehovah, my God, I pray thee, let this child's soul come into him again!

title: I Kings 17:22
text: And Jehovah heard the voice of Elijah, and the soul of the child came into him again, and he lived.

title: I Kings 17:23
text: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down from the upper chamber into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, See, thy son lives.

title: I Kings 17:24
text: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of Jehovah in thy mouth is truth.

title: I Kings 18:1
text: ¶And it came to pass after many days, that the word of Jehovah came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself to Ahab; and I will send rain upon the face of the earth.

title: I Kings 18:2
text: And Elijah went to shew himself to Ahab. And the famine was severe in Samaria.

title: I Kings 18:3
text: And Ahab called Obadiah, who was the steward of his house (now Obadiah feared Jehovah greatly;

title: I Kings 18:4
text: and it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of Jehovah, that Obadiah took a hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and maintained them with bread and water);

title: I Kings 18:5
text: and Ahab said to Obadiah, Go through the land, to all the fountains of water and to all the torrents, perhaps we may find grass to save the horses and the mules alive, so that we may not have to destroy some of [our] beasts.

title: I Kings 18:6
text: And they divided the land between them to pass through it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

title: I Kings 18:7
text: And as Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him; and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Is it indeed thou, my lord Elijah?

title: I Kings 18:8
text: And he said to him, I [am he]: go, say to thy lord, Behold Elijah!

title: I Kings 18:9
text: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou givest thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to put me to death?

title: I Kings 18:10
text: As Jehovah thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom whither my lord has not sent to seek thee; and when they said, He is not [here], he took an oath of the kingdom or nation that they found thee not.

title: I Kings 18:11
text: And now thou sayest, Go, say to thy lord, Behold Elijah!

title: I Kings 18:12
text: And it shall come to pass when I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of Jehovah shall carry thee whither I know not; and when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he will kill me; and I thy servant fear Jehovah from my youth.

title: I Kings 18:13
text: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of Jehovah, how I hid a hundred men of Jehovah's prophets by fifty in a cave, and maintained them with bread and water?

title: I Kings 18:14
text: And now thou sayest, Go, say to thy lord, Behold Elijah! and he will kill me.

title: I Kings 18:15
text: And Elijah said, As Jehovah of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will certainly shew myself to him to-day.

title: I Kings 18:16
text: Then Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him. And Ahab went to meet Elijah.

title: I Kings 18:17
text: ¶And it came to pass when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said to him, Is it thou, the troubler of Israel?

title: I Kings 18:18
text: And he said, I have not troubled Israel, but thou and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of Jehovah, and thou hast followed the Baals.

title: I Kings 18:19
text: And now send, gather to me all Israel to mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the Asherah four hundred, who eat at Jezebel's table.

title: I Kings 18:20
text: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.

title: I Kings 18:21
text: ¶Then Elijah drew near to all the people, and said, How long do ye halt between two opinions? if Jehovah be God, follow him; and if Baal, follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

title: I Kings 18:22
text: And Elijah said to the people, I, only I, remain a prophet of Jehovah; and Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.

title: I Kings 18:23
text: Let them therefore give us two bullocks: and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and put it on the wood, and put no fire; and I will sacrifice the other bullock, and put it on the wood, and put no fire.

title: I Kings 18:24
text: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of Jehovah; and the god that answers by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, The word is good.

title: I Kings 18:25
text: And Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, Choose one bullock for yourselves, and sacrifice it first; for ye are the many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire.

title: I Kings 18:26
text: And they took the bullock which had been given them, and sacrificed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning until noon, saying, O Baal, answer us! But there was no voice, and none answered. And they leaped about the altar that had been made.

title: I Kings 18:27
text: And it came to pass at noon that Elijah mocked them and said, Cry aloud; for he is a god; for he is meditating, or gone aside, or he is on a journey; perhaps he sleeps, and will awake.

title: I Kings 18:28
text: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with swords and spears, till the blood gushed out upon them.

title: I Kings 18:29
text: And it came to pass when midday was past, that they prophesied until the [time] of the offering up of the oblation; but there was neither voice, nor any that answered, nor any attention.

title: I Kings 18:30
text: Then Elijah said to all the people, Draw near to me. And all the people drew near to him. And he repaired the altar of Jehovah which was broken down.

title: I Kings 18:31
text: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of Jehovah came saying, Israel shall be thy name;

title: I Kings 18:32
text: and with the stones he built an altar in the name of Jehovah, and made a trench round about the altar, of the capacity of two measures of seed;

title: I Kings 18:33
text: and he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid it on the wood. And he said, Fill four pitchers with water, and pour it on the burnt-offering, and on the wood.

title: I Kings 18:34
text: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.

title: I Kings 18:35
text: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.

title: I Kings 18:36
text: And it came to pass at [the time of] the offering up of the oblation, that Elijah the prophet drew near, and said, Jehovah, God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things by thy word.

title: I Kings 18:37
text: Answer me, Jehovah, answer me, that this people may know that thou Jehovah art God, and [that] *thou* hast turned their heart back again.

title: I Kings 18:38
text: And the fire of Jehovah fell, and consumed the burnt-offering, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

title: I Kings 18:39
text: And all the people saw [it], and they fell on their faces and said, Jehovah, he is God! Jehovah, he is God!

title: I Kings 18:40
text: And Elijah said to them, Seize the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape! And they seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the torrent of Kishon, and slaughtered them there.

title: I Kings 18:41
text: ¶And Elijah said to Ahab, Go up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.

title: I Kings 18:42
text: And Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.

title: I Kings 18:43
text: And he said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up and looked, and said, [There is] nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.

title: I Kings 18:44
text: And it came to pass at the seventh time that he said, Behold there is a cloud, small as a man's hand, arising out of the sea. And he said, Go up, say to Ahab, Harness and go down, that the pour of rain stop thee not.

title: I Kings 18:45
text: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heavens became black [with] clouds and wind, and there was a great pour of rain. And Ahab got on the chariot, and went to Jizreel.

title: I Kings 18:46
text: And the hand of Jehovah was upon Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jizreel.

title: I Kings 19:1
text: ¶And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and in detail how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.

title: I Kings 19:2
text: And Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah saying, So do the gods [to me], and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to-morrow about this time!

title: I Kings 19:3
text: And when he saw [that], he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beer-sheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.

title: I Kings 19:4
text: And he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a certain broom-bush, and requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough: now, Jehovah, take my life; for I am not better than my fathers.

title: I Kings 19:5
text: And he lay down and slept under the broom-bush. And behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, Arise, eat!

title: I Kings 19:6
text: And he looked, and behold, at his head was a cake, baked on hot stones, and a cruse of water. And he ate and drank, and lay down again.

title: I Kings 19:7
text: And the angel of Jehovah came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise, eat; for the journey is too great for thee.

title: I Kings 19:8
text: And he arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb the mount of God.

title: I Kings 19:9
text: ¶And there he went into a cave, and lodged there. And behold, the word of Jehovah [came] to him, and he said to him, What doest thou here, Elijah?

title: I Kings 19:10
text: And he said, I have been very jealous for Jehovah the God of hosts; for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I am left, I alone, and they seek my life, to take it away.

title: I Kings 19:11
text: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before Jehovah. And behold, Jehovah passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and broke in pieces the rocks before Jehovah: Jehovah was not in the wind. And after the wind, an earthquake: Jehovah was not in the earthquake.

title: I Kings 19:12
text: And after the earthquake, a fire: Jehovah was not in the fire. And after the fire, a soft gentle voice.

title: I Kings 19:13
text: And it came to pass, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. And behold, a voice [came] to him and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?

title: I Kings 19:14
text: And he said, I have been very jealous for Jehovah the God of hosts; for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I am left, I alone, and they seek my life, to take it away.

title: I Kings 19:15
text: And Jehovah said to him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus; and when thou comest, anoint Hazael king over Syria;

title: I Kings 19:16
text: and Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint king over Israel; and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah shalt thou anoint prophet in thy stead.

title: I Kings 19:17
text: And it shall come to pass, [that] him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay; and him that escapeth the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.

title: I Kings 19:18
text: Yet I have left [myself] seven thousand in Israel, all the knees that have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth that hath not kissed him.

title: I Kings 19:19
text: ¶And he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was ploughing [with] twelve yokes before him, and he with the twelfth; and Elijah went over to him, and cast his mantle on him.

title: I Kings 19:20
text: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and I will follow thee. And he said to him, Go back again; for what have I done to thee?

title: I Kings 19:21
text: And he returned back from him, and took the yoke of oxen, and killed them, and boiled their flesh with the implements of the oxen, and gave to the people, and they ate. And he arose and went after Elijah, and ministered to him.

title: I Kings 20:1
text: ¶And Ben-Hadad king of Syria assembled all his host; and there were thirty-two kings with him, and horses and chariots; and he went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.

title: I Kings 20:2
text: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said to him, Thus says Ben-Hadad:

title: I Kings 20:3
text: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, the goodliest, are mine.

title: I Kings 20:4
text: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.

title: I Kings 20:5
text: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaks Ben-Hadad saying: I sent to thee indeed, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;

title: I Kings 20:6
text: but to-morrow about this time I will send my servants to thee, and they shall search thy house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thy sight, they shall put in their hand and take away.

title: I Kings 20:7
text: And the king of Israel called all the elders of the land and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this [man] seeks mischief; for he sent to me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.

title: I Kings 20:8
text: And all the elders and all the people said to him, Hearken not, nor consent.

title: I Kings 20:9
text: And he said to the messengers of Ben-Hadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do; but this thing I cannot do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.

title: I Kings 20:10
text: And Ben-Hadad sent to him and said, The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me!

title: I Kings 20:11
text: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell [him], Let not him that girdeth on boast himself as he that putteth off!

title: I Kings 20:12
text: ¶And it came to pass when he heard this word, as he was drinking, he and the kings in the tents, that he said to his servants, Set yourselves. And they set themselves against the city.

title: I Kings 20:13
text: And behold, a prophet drew near to Ahab king of Israel, and said, Thus saith Jehovah: Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thy hand this day; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.

title: I Kings 20:14
text: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith Jehovah: By the servants of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall begin the battle? And he said, Thou.

title: I Kings 20:15
text: And he numbered the servants of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two; and after them he numbered all the people, all the children of Israel, seven thousand.

title: I Kings 20:16
text: And they went out at noon; and Ben-Hadad drank himself drunk in the tents, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings that helped him.

title: I Kings 20:17
text: And the servants of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben-Hadad sent out, and they told him saying, There are men come out of Samaria.

title: I Kings 20:18
text: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.

title: I Kings 20:19
text: And these servants of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army that followed them.

title: I Kings 20:20
text: And they slew every one his man; and the Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them; and Ben-Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with the horsemen.

title: I Kings 20:21
text: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.

title: I Kings 20:22
text: ¶And the prophet drew near to the king of Israel, and said to him, Go, strengthen thyself, and understand, and see what thou shalt do; for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.

title: I Kings 20:23
text: And the servants of the king of Syria said to him, Their gods are gods of the mountains; therefore they were stronger than we; but if we fight against them on the plateau, shall we not be stronger than they?

title: I Kings 20:24
text: And do this: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put governors in their stead;

title: I Kings 20:25
text: and number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot; and we will fight against them on the plateau: shall we not be stronger than they? And he hearkened to their voice, and did so.

title: I Kings 20:26
text: And it came to pass, at the return of the year, that Ben-Hadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.

title: I Kings 20:27
text: And the children of Israel were numbered and victualled, and they went against them; and the children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of goats; but the Syrians filled the land.

title: I Kings 20:28
text: And the man of God drew near, and spoke to the king of Israel and said, Thus saith Jehovah: Because the Syrians have said, Jehovah is a god of the mountains, but he is not a god of the valleys, I will give all this great multitude into thy hand, and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

title: I Kings 20:29
text: And they encamped one over against the other seven days; and it came to pass that on the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel smote of the Syrians a hundred thousand footmen in one day.

title: I Kings 20:30
text: And the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men of them that were left. And Ben-Hadad fled, and came into the city, [from] chamber to chamber.

title: I Kings 20:31
text: ¶And his servants said to him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel; perhaps he will save thy life.

title: I Kings 20:32
text: And they girded sackcloth on their loins, and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Ben-Hadad says, I pray thee, let me live. And he said, Is he yet alive? he is my brother.

title: I Kings 20:33
text: And the men took it as a good omen, and hastened to catch what came from him, and they said, Thy brother Ben-Hadad. ...And he said, Go, bring him. And Ben-Hadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

title: I Kings 20:34
text: And [Ben-Hadad] said to him, The cities that my father took from thy father I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thyself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. And I [said Ahab] will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.

title: I Kings 20:35
text: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said to another by the word of Jehovah, Smite me, I pray thee. But the man refused to smite him.

title: I Kings 20:36
text: Then said he to him, Because thou hast not hearkened to the voice of Jehovah, behold, when thou departest from me, the lion will slay thee. And when he had departed from him, the lion found him and slew him.

title: I Kings 20:37
text: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him violently, and wounded [him].

title: I Kings 20:38
text: And the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with a sash over his eyes.

title: I Kings 20:39
text: And as the king passed by, he cried to the king and said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man to me and said, Keep this man; if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or thou shalt pay a talent of silver.

title: I Kings 20:40
text: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said to him, So [is] thy judgment: thyself hast decided [it].

title: I Kings 20:41
text: Then he hastily took the sash away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him, that he was of the prophets.

title: I Kings 20:42
text: And he said to him, Thus saith Jehovah: Because thou hast let go out of thy hand the man that I had devoted to destruction, thy life shall be for his life, and thy people for his people.

title: I Kings 20:43
text: And the king of Israel went to his house sullen and vexed, and came to Samaria.

title: I Kings 21:1
text: ¶And it came to pass after these things, [that] Naboth the Jizreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jizreel, by the side of the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

title: I Kings 21:2
text: And Ahab spoke to Naboth saying, Give me thy vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, for it is near, by the side of my house; and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it; if it seem good to thee, I will give thee its value in money.

title: I Kings 21:3
text: And Naboth said to Ahab, Jehovah forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to thee!

title: I Kings 21:4
text: And Ahab came into his house sullen and vexed because of the word that Naboth the Jizreelite had spoken to him; for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he lay down on his bed, and turned away his face, and ate no bread.

title: I Kings 21:5
text: ¶And Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, Why is thy spirit sullen, and thou eatest no bread?

title: I Kings 21:6
text: And he said to her, Because I spoke to Naboth the Jizreelite and said to him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee a vineyard for it; and he said, I will not give thee my vineyard.

title: I Kings 21:7
text: And Jezebel his wife said to him, Dost thou now exercise sovereignty over Israel? arise, eat bread, and let thy heart be glad: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jizreelite.

title: I Kings 21:8
text: And she wrote a letter in Ahab's name, and sealed it with his seal, and sent the letter to the elders and to the nobles that were in his city, dwelling with Naboth.

title: I Kings 21:9
text: And she wrote in the letter saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth at the head of the people;

title: I Kings 21:10
text: and set two men, sons of Belial, before him, and they shall bear witness against him saying, Thou didst curse God and the king; and carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.

title: I Kings 21:11
text: And the men of his city, the elders and the nobles that dwelt in his city, did as Jezebel had sent to them, as it was written in the letter that she had sent to them:

title: I Kings 21:12
text: they proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth at the head of the people.

title: I Kings 21:13
text: And there came the two men, sons of Belial, and sat before him; and the men of Belial witnessed against him, against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth blasphemed God and the king. And they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.

title: I Kings 21:14
text: And they sent to Jezebel saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.

title: I Kings 21:15
text: And it came to pass when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jizreelite, which he refused to give thee for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.

title: I Kings 21:16
text: And it came to pass when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jizreelite, to take possession of it.

title: I Kings 21:17
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

title: I Kings 21:18
text: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to take possession of it.

title: I Kings 21:19
text: And thou shalt speak unto him saying, Thus saith Jehovah: Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him saying, Thus saith Jehovah: In the place where the dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall the dogs lick thy blood, even thine.

title: I Kings 21:20
text: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, mine enemy? And he said, I have found [thee]; because thou hast sold thyself to do evil in the sight of Jehovah.

title: I Kings 21:21
text: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab every male, and him that is shut up and left in Israel;

title: I Kings 21:22
text: and I will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger, and made Israel to sin.

title: I Kings 21:23
text: And of Jezebel also spoke Jehovah saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the moat of Jizreel.
